## Mathematical corrections applied (the inherited attempt-2 manifest had real errors)
Checked against the fetched full texts (Brady–Watt, Steinberg, Casselman, Fomin–Reading) and re-derived A₃/I₂(5) computations:
1. False `{δ} = {θ}` set identity in the pairings lemma → replaced by Brady–Watt Cor. 6.12 (lex-first simplex).
2. False all-pairs sign claim τᵢ·τⱼ ≤ 0 for ℓ_T(σ)=2 (counterexample: I₂(5), ρ₁·ρ₂ = φ/2 > 0) → τ₁·τ_t ≤ 0 and τᵢ·τ_{i+1} ≥ 0 (Thm 5.4/Lemma 5.6).
3. μ₄ = μ₂ − 2α₂ → μ₄ = μ₂ − 2ρ₂ (matrix confirms).
4. "indices modulo 5" for cρᵢ → cρᵢ = ρ_{i+2} with ρ_{i+5} = −ρᵢ.
5. Inexact row-shift claim → exact c-cyclicity μ_{i+2}·ρ_{j+2} = μᵢ·ρⱼ with the negative-root boundary convention.
6–8. A₃ example: c = (1 2 4 3) (not (1 2 3 4)); vanishing "one and two" subdiagonals (t ≤ n−1); R(ρ₁)R(ρ₂)c = (2 3) (not (2 4)); criterion cited to the item that states it (dep added, level bumped).
9. The cone-vs-moved-space example was built on the *interleaved* Coxeter element; rewritten with the conjugate pair α = R(ρ₃)c, β = R(ρ₆)c, all four claims recomputed.
10. Steinberg-lemma strategy: sector count corrected to the faithful 2h dihedral orbit tiling P (⇒ θ = π/h).
